Name: Summerset 32" Sizzler Series Built-In Natural Gas Grill (SIZ32-NG)
Natural: The Sizzler Series Built-In Gas Grill, 32-Inch from Summerset combines high quality and high performance to provide a great option to complete your outdoor kitchen. The grill features a solid 443 stainless steel construction that's designed for durability and longevity while the heavy duty grill burners are built from a higher quality 304 stainless steel to ensure long lasting performance. Each of the (4) main grilling burners are rated for 12,000 BTU to provide high heat while the unique captured briquette trays provide even radiant heat across the 740in² cooking surface. The captured briquette trays provide additional heat and eliminate hot and cold zones as the 8mm thick stainless steel grates offer a thick gauge grilling surface for professional style grill marks. The 32" Sizzler also features a unique Flame Thrower Ignition that shoots a burst of flame to ignite the main burners and is much more reliable than traditional spark ignition systems. The insulated and double lined hood keeps hot air in to ensure a consistent grilling environment complete with a built in 3" temperature gauge to accurately monitor your grilling temperature. In addition, the 15,000 BTU infrared back burner offers a high quality rotisserie burner for professional style rotisserie cooking. Available for both propane and natural gas this built in grill is perfect to complete your outdoor kitchen.

Name: Weber 22 Performer Deluxe Charcoal Grill
Natural: Boasting 363 sq. in. of cooking space and a built-in metal prep table, Webers 22 Performer Deluxe Charcoal Grill provides room for every tool, plate and food item you need to prepare a delicious family meal. Electronic Touch-N-Go gas ignition system quickly ignites your charcoal briquettes with the simple push of a button, and the included thermometer ensures your cooking surface is always at the perfect temperature before you get started. Two Char-Basket holders hold your fuel and allow for both direct and indirect cooking applications. Gourmet BBQ System hinged cooking grates prevents foods from sticking, provides even heat distribution and allows you to use a wide variety of Weber grilling accessories. CharBin storage container provides space for storing charcoal where itll stay protected from the elements. Convenient One Touch cleaning system and high-capacity ash catcher make clean up a breeze. Durable porcelain-enameled lid and bowl. Heavy-duty steel cart frame. Made in USA incorporating globally sourced component parts. 41.25H x 50.25W x 28.5D. Color: Charcoal. Type: Charcoal Grills.
